rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs corrigendum F. No. 10/20/98-M&G of 14 August 1998 substitutes the first four lines of notification No. 10/1/98-M&G of 6 April 1998: the President has accepted the resignation of Shri I. K. Gujral of his office of the Prime Minister along with his colleagues in the Council of Ministers and 'advised them to continue till a new Government is formed', and 'the following members of the Council of Ministers have relinquished charge with effect from 19th March, 1998'.

locator.item: Corrigendum F. No. 10/20/98-M & G, New Delhi, the 14th August, 1998

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only. Deputy prime ministers, ministers, the President and party offices are excluded.
